scope: Synthetic Discord conversations through real chat/tool/vision paths. In-memory fake Discord/database destinations; native search/page responses controlled. Real search connectivity measured separately in deployment receipt.

originalHoldout.reason: A required refusal response was empty: non-routing direct questions were incorrectly forced through optional continuation. Original automated critical gate remains failed; no privacy disclosure occurred.
originalHoldout.judgeLimitation: The original semantic judge incorrectly described the empty output as a refusal; deterministic grading caught it. v2 explicitly forbids inventing a reply.

optimizationHistory.budgetDeviations: Original development revision budget extended from 2 to 3 to 4 before original holdout generation; all original protocols and failed outputs retained. No production source tuning after original holdout.

regressions.fullIndexTypecheck: A broader index.ts check still reports the existing api/utils/statistics.ts:577 GlobalStats/CTFAchievementStats mismatch. That file was not changed in this upgrade.

limits: Small synthetic cases and repeated trials are not statistically independent estimates of production accuracy.
Previous holdout confirmation is no longer unseen; only the 8 fresh validation cases were unseen after the harness correction.
All semantic scores on current runs were 5/5; this judge is lenient and not an independent human-native evaluation. Manual review retains wording limitations.
Input tokens increased about 2.3%; completion tokens decreased about 25.8%. p95 latency was slower in this run. No general speed or cost reduction is claimed.
Controlled synthetic search does not measure real web retrieval quality; actual API authentication, native sources and turn caching have separate smoke evidence.
No claim of global optimum, genuine feelings or full human Discord-client parity.
